en_title: CD Projekt Confirms Layoffs on The Witcher Multiplayer Spinoff, Issues Statement
cn_title: CDPR确认《巫师》多人项目裁员
subtitle: 进展仍不顺
opus_summary: CD Projekt确认《巫师》多人项目裁员，波士顿4人、华沙5人离职，另有9人可申请其他岗位。人数由83人降至预计约60人，目前暂无取消迹象。

paragraphs.en: CD Projekt has confirmed layoffs on The Witcher multiplayer spinoff, codenamed Project Sirius.
paragraphs.cn: CD Projekt确认，代号为Project Sirius的《巫师》多人衍生项目团队已裁员。

paragraphs.en: First reported by Kotaku , nine staff working on the game were cut. In a statement issued to IGN, CD Projekt confirmed four staff in its Boston office and five in its Warsaw headquarters lost their jobs, with nine others told they could apply for potential roles on other projects. As of April 30, Project Sirius had 83 staff working on it. That number is now presumably closer to 60.
paragraphs.cn: Kotaku率先报道，该游戏有9名员工被裁。CD Projekt在发给IGN的声明中确认，波士顿办公室4名员工和华沙总部5名员工失去了工作，另有9人获告知可以申请其他项目中可能提供的职位。截至4月30日，Project Sirius共有83名员工参与开发。如今，这一数字预计已更接近60人。

paragraphs.en: “We adjusted the size of the Sirius team to reflect the project’s needs at this stage of development,” CD Projekt said. As a result, four people in Boston and five in Warsaw are leaving the company, while nine others have been invited to internal recruitment processes for potential roles on other CD Projekt Red projects.”
paragraphs.cn: CD Projekt表示：「我们调整了Sirius团队的规模，以符合项目现阶段的需求。因此，波士顿4名员工和华沙5名员工将离开公司，另有9人获邀参加内部招聘流程，以申请CDPR其他项目中可能提供的职位。」

paragraphs.en: CD Projekt brought Boston-based The Flame in the Flood developer The Molasses Flood into the fold to make Sirius back in 2021, but it has suffered difficulties in the years since. Indeed, this isn’t the first time it’s had layoffs. In 2023, CD Projekt said Sirius had a "new framework" after restarting development . Layoffs followed.
paragraphs.cn: 早在2021年，CD Projekt就将总部位于波士顿、曾开发《洪潮之焰》的The Molasses Flood纳入旗下，负责开发Sirius，但该工作室此后的几年里一直困难重重。事实上，这已经不是该工作室第一次裁员。2023年，CD Projekt表示，Sirius在重启开发后采用了「全新框架」。随后，团队又出现了裁员。

paragraphs.en: There is no suggestion today that Project Sirius is canceled, but it is now nearly four years since it was announced and CD Projekt has yet to show anything of the game. Meanwhile, the company is hard at work on The Witcher 4 (513 staff), Cyberpunk 2 (163 staff), and new IP Project Hadar (24 staff). There’s also a The Witcher 3 expansion coming next year and a remake of The Witcher 1.
paragraphs.cn: 目前没有迹象表明Project Sirius已被取消，但距离项目公布已经近四年，CD Projekt至今仍未展示任何游戏内容。与此同时，公司正全力开发《巫师4》（513名员工）、《赛博朋克2》（163名员工）和全新IP Project Hadar（24名员工）。此外，明年还将推出《巫师3》扩展内容，《巫师1》重制版也在制作中。

paragraphs.en: On top of that, CD Projekt has an extremely ambitious plan to launch The Witcher 4, The Witcher 5, and The Witcher 6 all in a six-year time period . It's this plan which essentially rules out the possibility of expansions for The Witcher 4. And then there’s Cyberpunk 2 to slot in at some point.
paragraphs.cn: 不仅如此，CD Projekt还制定了一个极其雄心勃勃的计划，打算在6年内陆续推出《巫师4》《巫师5》和《巫师6》。正是这项计划，基本排除了《巫师4》推出扩展内容的可能性。此外，公司还得在某个时间点把《赛博朋克2》排进日程。
